name: rendering-mesh
description: Procedural shape rendering: circles, lines, filled rects, gradient paths, composites
postInstallNotes:
## rendering-mesh installed

Shape rendering through `IMeshGenerator`. The interface and canonical implementations (`CircleMeshGenerator`, `LineMeshGenerator`, `RectangleOutlineMeshGenerator`, `FilledRectangleMeshGenerator`, `GradientPathMeshGenerator`, `CompositeMeshGenerator`) all ship in `MonoDreams/Draw/IMeshGenerator.cs`.

Usage:
1. Set `DrawComponent.Type = DrawElementType.Mesh` and assign an `IMeshGenerator` (e.g. on a `MeshInfo` field your code drives).
2. Add `MeshPrepSystem` to your update pipeline before `MasterRenderSystem`.

Mesh generators output triangle lists; `MasterRenderSystem` submits them via the same SpriteBatch path.

**Premises:** `docs/rendering/premises.md`
